roll_policy: reset features at roll_transition and exclude outcomes crossing a roll
time_policy: UTC source; America/New_York session labels; session begins 18:00 ET; valid-bar horizons
corrections_frozen_before_rerun: Remove the 17:00-18:00 New York maintenance rows before every feature and forward horizon; preserve original roll-segment identities.
Fix rolling regression index origin: prices weighted with indices 1..n require subtracting (window_start+1)*sum_prices before centering against 0..n-1.
Require all stack averages and slopes available before classifying stack states; missing is not neutral.
Clamp favorable/adverse excursion magnitudes at zero.
Rename bucket-index Pearson correlation rather than imply a rank/Spearman test; unresolved-or-no-touch labels include same-bar ambiguity.

Exclude forward windows crossing the predefined evaluation-period boundaries. The earlier code let a final development/validation decision use prices from the next period; the reused rules cannot become untouched evidence retrospectively.
frozen_rule_policy: Reuse earlier four diagnostic definitions unchanged. No selection or retuning from this rerun. Previously examined 2025-latest is a later-period recheck, not a fresh untouched holdout.
same_clock_reference: All eligible decisions at the same New York session-minute in the same evaluation period; includes qualifying decisions, retrospective benchmark, no year/volatility matching.
result_precision: Aggregate CSVs saved with 10 significant digits; full precision retained while calculating.
scope: All saved moving-average, slope, regression-bucket and stack grid definitions rerun; no claim every hypothetical slow filter fails.
